items.evidence: Seed 1 full run at Normal with my own script (judge-scratch/script1.txt): wave 5 cleared by tick ~4920 at 450 points; wave 6 starts at ~5100; 15 walkers of kind runner, health 1, x drops 1.5 per 30 ticks (3 u/s), spawned 90 ticks apart (5110, 5200, 5290 ...).

HUD texts 'Wave 1 of 6' ... 'Wave 6 of 6', 'Oleada 6 de 6', 'Vague 6 sur 6'. Same run: no win at the end of wave 5 (wave 6 at 450 points), won at tick ~6460 with 675, gate 5. With the last runner left alone it went through (gate 5->4) and the run was won at 660.

Right on Language: English -> Español -> Français (Left goes back). French texts seen: title [Tenez la porte, Commencer, Réglages, Quitter], settings [Réglages, Volume : 8, Langue : Français, Difficulté : ..., Retour], play [Score : 0, Vague 1 sur 6, Porte : 5], paused [Pause, Reprendre, Titre], won [Vous avez gagné, Score : 675, Entrée : titre], lost [Vous avez perdu, Score : 0, Entrée : titre]; frames match.

Settings texts [Settings, Volume, Language, Difficulty: Normal, Back] (Difficulty is menu_index 2, between Language and Back); Left -> Easy, Right -> Normal -> Hard; shown as Facile/Normal/Difficile in French and Fácil in Spanish; default Normal in a new settings folder.
Hard: wave 1 walker health 3; --set wave=6 runner health 2. Easy: runner health 1, walker health 1 (game check 'easy walkers' and my run). Normal: walkers 2, runners 1 (seed 1 full run).

Hard + French set in one run were the next run's values (same --settings folder; settings.json holds difficulty hard). A hand-written old settings.json with only volume 3 and language es loaded: volume 3, Spanish, difficulty normal, walkers health 2.
State prints "difficulty" (normal/easy/hard), each walker has "kind" (walker/runner); --frame writes 800 x 480 PNGs (header read for 6 frames).

Re-ran m01-m19: title texts and Down/Enter/Start; volume 8->10 stops, 0 stops; Spanish everywhere; volume/language kept, fresh folder defaults; guard 0.1/tick, stops at 12 and 0; bolt every 24 ticks, 14 u/s, gone past 20; wave 1 = 5 walkers 90 ticks apart at 1.5 u/s in lanes 2-10; hit 2->1->gone +10, bolts in lane 6 pass walkers in 2/4/8; gate 5->4 at the gate, lost at 0 with score; wave 2 exactly 180 ticks after wave 1's last walker, 7 walkers; full clear 675 (450 read as 675) and Enter -> title; pause freezes walkers and bolts, Resume continues, Title returns; same seed identical output, seed 2 other lanes; frames place guard, walkers, bolts and HUD where the state says; README commands run as written.

CHANGES.md lists each change with its file (lib.rs, fr.json, game.json settings, settings.json screen, strings), what was checked and how (--at runs, wave=6 hook, leverage check 3/3), and what was not checked.

defects: The state's "difficulty" reads "normal" on the title and settings screens even when the saved or just-chosen difficulty is Hard or Easy; it becomes right only once a run starts.
The Language and Difficulty settings stop at the ends (Right on French stays French) rather than wrapping round. The order is right.
The settings frame shows a faint copy of the title text behind the 'Réglages' heading (the title screen showing through the settings screen).

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
